key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle-speed and spray-distance selection to target coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive relationships and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships of roughness and thickness with nozzle travel speed, and parabolic relationships of roughness and contact angle with spray distance.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges or prediction errors, so applicability to other spray systems requires validation.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
